gap.title: Least lift-fixed circuits are clean: in a least lift-fixed fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for a 4-cycle-free bipartite edge function, every AND gate is below F
gap.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (s : Fin n → Bool),
  (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → s u ≠ s v) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO G C →
  PEqualNP.Core.IsLiftFixedPoint G C →
  ∀ k < C.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and →
    PEqualNP.TopForm.BelowF G C k
gap.unlocks: the one-line form of the plane question: with a checked normal form it gives edges plus cover minus one
gap.context: SKETCH: No proof is in hand, and with a checked normal form for least circuits this statement gives the full size bound on graphs with no 4-cycle, so none is expected to be short. Known on paper: one AND that is not below F can be removed at no larger size; every least circuit of the small bipartite classes on file is clean (by script). On graphs WITH a 4-cycle two explicit 9-gate lift-fixed circuits have such an AND; that they are least is computed only. Open case: two such ANDs whose cones share a gate other tops read. Size: open. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
